summary.text: La'Tasha Mayes is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 24 who has served since December 1, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Mayes founded and led the organization New Voices for Reproductive Justice before entering the legislature.

paragraphs.text: La'Tasha Mayes was born in Fort Riley, Kansas.
She earned a B.S. in business administration from the University of Pittsburgh in 2003 and an M.S. in public policy and management from Carnegie Mellon University in 2005.
Her career experience includes founding New Voices for Reproductive Justice and working as its CEO, and working as a consultant and in a family law clinic at the YWCA.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Mayes said she founded New Voices for Reproductive Justice in Pittsburgh in 2004.
In that survey she listed racial, gender, reproductive, economic and environmental justice, LGBTQ+ rights and healthcare access among the policy areas she is passionate about.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Appropriations, Environmental Resources and Energy, Health, and Judiciary committees.
